time.desc: The boy involved publicly denied the sexual harassment accusation for the first time, and disclosed that he had filed a complaint against the school's punishment and filed a civil lawsuit for reputation infringement against the parties involved in the online posting, which was filed by the court.

The family members of the boy involved issued a systematic response on social platforms, claiming that the accusation article contained many falsehoods and disclosed that the person involved suffered a serious psychological crisis due to online violence, triggering a significant reversal in public opinion.
There was a clear reversal in the public opinion field, and the mainstream sentiment shifted from questioning the man to sympathizing with the man and questioning the woman’s accusation.

The mother of the accused party spoke out publicly for the first time on social platforms such as Platform A and Platform B, and made a systematic response to the accusation articles previously published by the accuser.

The accused party clearly denied the existence of sexual harassment, and pointed out one by one that there were many false information in the accusing article, such as altering the content of the apology letter, falsely claiming that the other party left a false name, fabricating witness testimony, and fabricating financial compensation.
The accused party disclosed that the client had suffered from disease D due to large-scale online violence and had tried to commit suicide several times.
The accused party’s public response quickly appeared on the hot search lists on multiple platforms, pushing the incident to show signs of a major reversal.

The accused party disclosed the progress of rights protection through the media, saying that it had filed a complaint with the school and attached medical records to request the withdrawal of the punishment.

Person C disclosed through media F that the accused party has hired a lawyer to file a civil lawsuit against the online platform that first posted the report on the grounds of defamation and infringement of reputation rights, and completed the filing of the case, requiring the post to be deleted and an apology to be provided and the real-name registration information of the public account involved to be provided.

The accused party is preserving evidence from accounts that spread false information about recruitment scandals, plagiarism and falsification of papers, etc., and is advancing the case filing process.

The staff of Person C’s disclosure agency K repeatedly stated in the communication recording that it was not sexual harassment, that sexual harassment had been ruled out, and that it was an emergency response at the time, but the demerit penalty against the accused party was never revoked.

The accuser filed a lawsuit against the boy involved in the court regarding the "dispute over liability for sexual harassment damages" and completed the filing of the case, requesting a public apology and compensation for mental damage.
This civil dispute case has completed several closed court hearings and entered a long waiting stage for judgment.

A warehouse appeared on the code hosting platform that disclosed the personal information and academic clues of the parties in the name of "supporting the victims." The incident spilled over into a wider network of unboxing and mobilization
The court's first-instance judgment concluded that the existing evidence was insufficient to confirm that the boy involved had committed sexual harassment and dismissed all the prosecution's claims.
The family of the boy involved filed a civil lawsuit against the school's disciplinary sanctions, requesting relief such as the revocation of the sanctions and restoration of reputation.
The school involved issued an official notice stating that it respects judicial decisions and launched a special investigation and review of disciplinary sanctions and academic integrity issues.
The content platform issued a management announcement to permanently ban accounts that pretend to be relevant identities and spread false information.
The accuser appealed against the first-instance judgment and was accepted by the second-instance court, and the case entered the second-instance procedure.
